description: She wears an opaque teal floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves and gold cloud-and-knot borders at neckline, waist, sleeves, front skirt edges and hem. Round gold brooches secure the shoulders and belt. A pale patterned fringed wrap rests along her forearms and hangs down both sides. A cream underdress appears through the modest front opening below the knee; brown closed shoes are visible beneath the hem. No headgear, armor or weapon; substantial opaque fabric covers bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis.
